description: Find destination pages ads drive to — what users call 'landing pages'. Filter by pageTypes (offer_page, advertorial, listicle, quiz, lead_capture, homepage, pdp, collection, blog, marketplace, app_store, social_profile) and by the technologies detected on the site, e.g. Shopify or Klaviyo. `search` first matches pages whose title, description or URL contain every word, best match first, then fills the page with semantic matches. Each row has one picture; the matching get_ tool returns every creative, screenshot, logo and the page HTML. Fields this workspace can't see are null and named in the item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits, traffic). A capped list sets `planLimit` (`maxResults`, `hiddenResults`) and has no next page. Never estimate omitted values. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same call, to get the next page. Keep every other argument the same.

limit.description: Results per page: 20 by default, up to 40. Use the user's number when they give one; for more than 40, page with cursor.

pageTypes.description: CSV of landing-page types: offer_page,advertorial,listicle,quiz,lead_capture,homepage,pdp,collection,blog,marketplace,app_store,social_profile. The stored names product, squeeze and other still work.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_site_pages
title: Find landing pages
